messages:
omar: Quick check-in post-launch 1: do we want a hard bugs-only sprint or a split runway? I9m leaning 60/40 bugs:enhancements for two sprints. Thoughts?

jen: 60/40 seems reasonable. We need a rule for low-effort/high-impact enhancers that can sneak into the fast-path. Maybe <4h PRs with product sign-off?

tess: Agree on the <4h filter. Also propose we prioritize customer-configured routes and any regression affecting billed customers for P0.

omar: Proposed fast-path rules: P0 blocking for paying customers -> immediate triage. Fast small enhancers (<4h + no infra churn) -> fast lane if PM approves. All others go into backlog grooming.

greg: Ops note: we can guarantee one hotfix slot per day during sprint week for fast-path merges (subject to canary). Need to reserve a release window. @release-bot can we lock 18:00-19:00 UTC daily?

release-bot: release window reserved: daily-hotfix-2109998888 from 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z to 2026-03-25T19:00:00Z. See internal runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/daily-hotfix.

jen: Acceptance criteria for a sprint-green: no regression-caused escalations, zero data-loss incidents, and slippage <10% of planned bug fixes. For the enhancement fast-lane, require owner + test coverage + rollout flag.

tess: Telemetry thresholds: error budget <2% for major flows, p99 latency <400ms during canary window, and rollout hold if SLA breach.

omar: Roadmap update: I'll tag the next two sprints in the roadmap doc and change the theme to "postlaunch stabilization + small wins". Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/roadmap#afterglow.

greg: I'll create the GH label "postlaunch-afterglow" and a board column for fast-path candidates. Also will schedule the daily hotfix window in the oncall calendar.

jen: One wrinkle: a customer requested a small tweak to reranking that is high-impact for them but non-blocking. Recommend we treat as fast-path if it meets the <4h + tests rule and we can ship behind a flag.

omar: Approved. Michael/CS should get a heads-up. Assign owner when issues created.

greg: Creating a Jira swimlane: P0-hotfix, fast-path (<4h enhancers), backlog. Will add acceptance checklist to tickets.

jen: Weekly sync cadence? Propose Tue 09:30 for quick status, and ad-hoc P0 huddle when needed.

omar: Sounds good. Decision: two sprints, 60/40 bug:enhancement, fast-path rules as above, daily hotfix window reserved. We'll reassess after sprint 2.

jen: :thumbsup:

tess: :rocket:

greg: :thumbsup:
